description_en: Queries resource information under a resource discovery
description_zh: 查询资源发现下的资源信息
kebab_example: aliyun vpcipam list-ipam-discovered-resource --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipam-resource-discovery-id ipam-res-disco-jt5f2af2u6nk2z3210000 --resource-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListIpamDiscoveredResource

parameters.help_en:
The hosted region ID of the resource discovery instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
资源发现实例的托管地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The operating region of the resource discovery
parameters.name: resource_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. Valid values:

VPC: VPC.

VSwitch: vSwitch
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型。取值：

VPC：表示资源类型为VPC。

VSwitch：表示资源类型为交换机
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token. Valid values:

If this is the first query or no subsequent query exists, leave this parameter empty.
If a subsequent query exists, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时返回的最多条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值为10
parameters.name: max_results

Count.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
Count.description_zh: 分批次查询时返回的具体条目数

Cidr.description_en: The CIDR block of the resource

DiscoveryTime.description_en:
The time when the resource was discovered.

If the resource has not been modified since it was created, the discovery time remains unchanged
DiscoveryTime.description_zh:
资源被发现的时间。

如果资源被创建后未被修改过，资源被发现的时间保持不变

IpCountDetail.description_en: The details of the resource IP address count
IpCountDetail.description_zh: 资源 IP 地址数量详情

FreeIpCount.description_en: The number of available IP addresses
FreeIpCount.description_zh: 可分配 IP 地址数量

TotalIpCount.description_en: The total number of IP addresses

UsedIpCount.description_en: The number of allocated IP addresses
UsedIpCount.description_zh: 已分配 IP 地址数量

IpUsage.description_en: The IP utilization rate, in decimal format

ResourceOwnerId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the resource ownership
ResourceOwnerId.description_zh: 资源归属的阿里云账号（主账号）ID

ResourceRegionId.description_en: The region ID of the resource ownership

ResourceType.description_en:
The resource type. Valid values:

VPC: VPC.

VSwitch: vSwitch
ResourceType.description_zh:
资源类型。取值：

VPC：表示资源类型为VPC。

VSwitch：表示资源类型为交换机

VpcId.description_en: The instance ID of the VPC-connected instance to which the resource belongs

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时返回的最多条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值为10

NextToken.description_en:
The pagination token. Valid values:
If NextToken is empty, no subsequent query exists.
If NextToken has a return value, the value indicates the token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries that match the query conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 本次请求条件下的数据总量
